source.sourceLessonTitleEnglish: Safety Compliance Officer Walks the Scaffold
source.sourceObjectiveEnglish: Walk a safety compliance officer through scaffold inspections and records using formal, precise language.
source.sourceSpeakingEnglish: You are the foreman, and the AI is compliance officer Inés Carrillo: walk her along the north-face scaffold and explain who inspects it, how often your safety plan requires it and where the records are, using formal usted and passive se (se inspecciona, se registra).

openDomainReview.question: Keep Inés Carrillo's compliance-officer role and the company's own safety-plan inspection frequency attributed to this scene. Preserve Julio Paredes as both scaffold erector and designated competent person. Review the Japanese trade and role terms; do not turn the company policy into a universal legal frequency.

Preserve cross braces, top rail, midrail, toe board on open sides, inspection log and tag as distinct parts and records. Review technical Japanese and any locale-dependent scaffold terminology with a qualified scaffold specialist.

The green tag on section 3 lacks today's signature. Rubén bars access until the designated competent person inspects and signs; Julio then records and signs, and Rubén promises today's corrective-action record by email. Do not infer that tag color alone certifies safe access. Review the draft phrase's 'inspection supervisor' wording against the source's 'competent person'.

The compliance-officer exchange is formal, while the radio instruction to the crew is informal. Review Japanese register and source Spanish usted/passive se adaptation before selecting full Reader turns, authored mode targets or recording scripts.

rows.sourceSpanish: La oficial de cumplimiento Inés Carrillo llega a la obra de acero de la calle Main para inspeccionar el andamio de la fachada norte.
rows.sourceEnglish: Compliance officer Inés Carrillo arrives at the steel job on Main Street to inspect the scaffold on the north face.

rows.sourceSpanish: El capataz, Rubén Ortega, la acompaña por la escalera de acceso hasta la primera plataforma.
rows.sourceEnglish: The foreman, Rubén Ortega, goes with her up the access ladder to the first platform.

rows.sourceSpanish: Inés: ¿Quién inspecciona este andamio y cuál es la frecuencia de inspección que exige su empresa?
rows.sourceEnglish: Inés: Who inspects this scaffold, and what inspection frequency does your company require?
rows.speaker: Inés

rows.sourceSpanish: Rubén: Lo inspecciona Julio Paredes, nuestro andamiero y persona competente designada.
rows.sourceEnglish: Rubén: Julio Paredes inspects it; he is our scaffold erector and designated competent person.
rows.speaker: Rubén

rows.sourceSpanish: Rubén: Según nuestro plan de seguridad, se revisa antes de cada turno.
rows.sourceEnglish: Rubén: Under our safety plan, it's checked before every shift.
rows.speaker: Rubén
rows.conditionalJapanesePhrase: 当社の安全計画に基づき、毎シフト前に点検されています。

rows.sourceSpanish: Rubén: En cada revisión se verifica que las crucetas estén completas y bien aseguradas.
rows.sourceEnglish: Rubén: At each check, it is verified that the cross braces are complete and properly secured.
rows.speaker: Rubén

rows.sourceSpanish: Inés empuja el barandal superior y luego revisa el barandal intermedio.
rows.sourceEnglish: Inés pushes on the top rail and then checks the midrail.

rows.sourceSpanish: Rubén: El rodapié se instala en todos los lados abiertos para que no caigan herramientas a la calle.
rows.sourceEnglish: Rubén: The toe board is installed on all open sides so that no tools fall to the street.
rows.speaker: Rubén

rows.sourceSpanish: Inés: ¿Dónde se guardan los registros de estas inspecciones?
rows.sourceEnglish: Inés: Where are the records of these inspections kept?
rows.speaker: Inés

rows.sourceSpanish: Rubén: Los resultados se anotan en la bitácora y en la tarjeta.
rows.sourceEnglish: Rubén: The results are written in the log and on the tag.
rows.speaker: Rubén
rows.conditionalJapanesePhrase: 結果は点検記録簿とタグに記入されます。

rows.sourceSpanish: Rubén: Aquí tiene la bitácora de inspecciones de este mes, oficial Carrillo.
rows.sourceEnglish: Rubén: Here is this month's inspection log, Officer Carrillo.
rows.speaker: Rubén
rows.conditionalJapanesePhrase: カリージョさん、こちらが今月の点検記録簿です。

rows.sourceSpanish: Rubén: ¿Desea ver los certificados de capacitación de los andamieros?
rows.sourceEnglish: Rubén: Would you like to see the scaffold erectors' training certificates?
rows.speaker: Rubén
rows.conditionalJapanesePhrase: 足場組立作業員の研修修了証をご覧になりますか。

rows.sourceSpanish: Inés revisa los certificados y después señala que la tarjeta verde del tramo 3 no tiene la firma de hoy.
rows.sourceEnglish: Inés reviews the certificates and then points out that the green tag on section 3 doesn't have today's signature.

rows.sourceSpanish: Rubén: Tiene razón; a esta tarjeta le falta la firma.
rows.sourceEnglish: Rubén: You're right; this tag is missing the signature.
rows.speaker: Rubén
rows.conditionalJapanesePhrase: ご指摘のとおりです。このタグには署名が入っていません。

rows.sourceSpanish: Rubén avisa por radio a la cuadrilla: Muchachos, no suban a este tramo hasta nuevo aviso.
rows.sourceEnglish: Rubén tells the crew over the radio: Guys, don't go up on this section until further notice.
rows.speaker: Rubén tells the crew over the radio
rows.conditionalJapanesePhrase: みんな、追って連絡があるまで、この部分の足場には上がらないで。

rows.sourceSpanish: Rubén: Nadie sube hasta que la persona competente lo revise y firme.
rows.sourceEnglish: Rubén: Nobody goes up until the competent person checks and signs it.
rows.speaker: Rubén
rows.conditionalJapanesePhrase: 指名された点検責任者が点検し、署名するまで、誰も足場に上がりません。

rows.sourceSpanish: Julio inspecciona el tramo 3, anota el resultado en la bitácora y firma la tarjeta verde.
rows.sourceEnglish: Julio inspects section 3, writes the result in the log and signs the green tag.

rows.sourceSpanish: Rubén: La acción correctiva se documenta hoy y se la envío por correo.
rows.sourceEnglish: Rubén: The corrective action is documented today, and I'll email it to you.
rows.speaker: Rubén
rows.conditionalJapanesePhrase: 是正措置は本日記録し、メールでお送りします。
